participants.note: Concept ACK; noted local block-explorer use case and asked about behavior on already-pruned nodes
suggested partial index enabling support on already-pruned nodes (resolved)
Concept ACK, but raised interface questions on prune flags and structured RPC data

claims.harm: txindex cannot be enabled on an already pruned node without full history
claims.quote: However, it would have the big upside that it could be enabled on an already pruned node.
claims.settled_by_quote: I've updated this change to also allow starting an index with an already pruned node.

claims.harm: AllowPrune and AllowPartialHistory booleans have an unexpressed dependency that could break invariants in future indexes
claims.quote: Would a single enum value express that relationship better, so the invariant lives in the type instead of a convention that a future index could break?

claims.harm: missing block hashes are only returned inside error strings requiring callers to parse text to automate fetches
claims.quote: Right now those hashes only reach the caller inside the error string, so automating the fetch and retry means parsing the message. Would returning them as structured data be worth it?

support.reason: I think expected block usage is about 100GB per year, so 5 years worth of history would be half a terabyte, and probably cover most lookups... Concept ACK, looks okay to me at first glance.

Concept ACK. I'm excited about this PR and I love the idea and the approach... we can even access txs on pruned nodes, since #35531 the index stores the block 'virtual' reference rather than a file position

result.notes: Recorded Concept ACKs from l0rinc, ajtowns, and arejula27. Author resolved mzumsande's concern by supporting indexing on already-pruned nodes; arejula27's interface suggestions on prune flags and structured RPC data remain open.
